case: MongoDB app browse keyset query and large collection offset cost

regression.baseline_result: Failed before the fix with Unsupported: MongoDB bound reads support a single selected value by _id
regression.fixed_result: 2 passed against MongoDB 7; integer and canonical ObjectId cursors returned following rows in ascending _id order

native_regression.command: cargo test --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-driver-mongodb --test integration browse_keyset -- --ignored --nocapture
native_regression.result: 2 passed against MongoDB 7: integer and ObjectId _id cursors

large_collection_profile.result: 1 passed; five samples per 50-row page at offsets 0, midpoint and tail for 1k/10k/100k/1m rows

remaining: Filtered, sorted and keyless deep-page behavior is not covered by this regression or profile.
The timing uses local Docker and debug builds; realistic network latency is unmeasured.
Installed Arch/Wayland and Debian/GNOME browsing acceptance remains open.
The driver offset API remains linear for direct callers; the GUI uses keyset queries after the shared 10,000-row threshold.
